## Operational Context

This application targets industrial energy systems under changing operating conditions. The core requirement is to improve efficiency while respecting process boundaries.

- Representative application context: validated in industrial operating environments.
- Primary objective: improve operating efficiency while maintaining stable operation.
- Constraints: process limits, equipment boundaries, and actuator operating ranges.

## Method Architecture

<div class="project-figure-card">
<img src="/assets/images/projects/power/thermal_process_overview.png" alt="Energy-system efficiency-loop main interface">

- Robust constrained optimization for setpoint recommendation.
- Condition-adaptive feasible-set tightening for robust operation under uncertainty.
- Data-assisted recommendation modules to reduce online latency.
- Staged release workflow with replay validation.

## Measured Impact

- Measurable efficiency improvement was observed across representative operating scenarios.
- Better diagnosis support was available through gap-analysis and trend interfaces.
- Stable workflow behavior was maintained under varied operating conditions.

## Application Notes

- Template reuse supported faster adaptation in similar environments.
- Strategy release followed staged validation and review safeguards.
- Reported gains were scenario-dependent and varied with operating conditions.
